title: Figure 7: Witness sketch of pale, hunched "shape shifter" creature with long tail
description: Simple pen sketch of a thin, hairless, ape-like creature walking on all fours with a hunched back, a long curled tail, a small head with a pointed ear, and its hands on the ground. The caption reads "Figure 7 - Creature witnessed by [redacted] with his grandson [redacted]. Illustration by [redacted] on April 21, 2010," with names redacted under 1843(a)(2). The accompanying text says the witness described the creature as a "shape shifter," pale and furless, that jumped a fence and ran using its hands in a chimpanzee-like manner.
